major_cooldowns.name: Army of the Dead
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it on cooldown once the Festering Scythe haste buff is running, and pair Dark Transformation with every cast.

major_cooldowns.name: Cursed Stone Idol
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Start its channel so the crit buff lands as Army of the Dead and Dark Transformation go out.
major_cooldowns.id_note: On-use trinket named in the guide opener; the id was resolved by name lookup and was not observed in the sampled parses, so a player on other trinkets shows zero casts.

major_cooldowns.name: Dark Transformation
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Macro it into Army of the Dead for Commander of the Dead, and time the use between Army windows with add spawns.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 1233448 is the cast; the 15 sec self buff logs as 1235391.

major_cooldowns.name: Putrefy
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Spend its charges inside Dark Transformation, and press it on cooldown while Forbidden Knowledge is up.

rule.description: Open Outbreak into Army of the Dead and Dark Transformation
rule.action: Land Outbreak and a Festering Scythe first, then chain Army of the Dead, Dark Transformation and Putrefy.

rule.description: Dark Transformation macroed into Army of the Dead
rule.action: Macro Dark Transformation into Army of the Dead so Commander of the Dead empowers every pet it summons.

rule.description: Spend every Sudden Doom proc before it expires
rule.action: Fire Death Coil the moment Sudden Doom procs, or Epidemic when you are on several targets.

rule.description: Keep Virulent Plague up on your target
rule.action: Reapply it with Outbreak the moment it falls off.

rule.description: Scourge Strike while you hold Lesser Ghoul stacks
rule.action: Spend your Lesser Ghoul stacks with Scourge Strike and save Festering Strike for when they run out.

rule.description: Epidemic instead of Death Coil in AoE
rule.action: Swap your Runic Power dump from Death Coil to Epidemic once the pack is stacked up.

rule.description: Blightfall at the end of Dark Transformation
rule.action: Send Blightfall as the Dark Transformation window closes, or just before your on-use trinket buff ends.

rule.description: Keep the Festering Scythe haste buff up
rule.action: Press Festering Scythe as its buff runs low so your plagues keep ticking faster.
